resources.string: On the watch, press and hold the current face, swipe to Add watch face, and choose Cyberpunk HUD. To customize, press and hold the face and tap Customize. Choose a theme, layout, AOD style, and complication providers.

ADB install: enable Developer options and Wireless debugging on the watch. Pair with adb pair WATCH_IP:PAIRING_PORT, connect with adb connect WATCH_IP:DEBUG_PORT, then run adb install -r watchface-debug.apk.
Privacy: this app collects no data, shows no ads, and makes no network calls.
